lines: I could hear Hebiko's scream from the mansion's garden.
This was bad. We were in a predicament.
At that time, Koro-senpai and I had left the site.
Just as we got outside, we had seen a figure hiding behind the stone-built mansion.
「（You mean that's the person controlling the mud?）」
She had the look of an indoors-y type, but her movements were sharper than I expected.
「I know Koro-senpai carries a ninja sword on her back, but what's your fighting style?」
I had brought her along as a necessary combatant, but I couldn't yet grasp how to best make use of her as a military asset.
As we moved, I checked to see whether she was good at close-quarters combat, whether a long-range attack would be possible, things like that.
「（I may not look like it, but I'm a Stray Blade Style swordfighter.）」
Koro-senpai said proudly, in a still-quiet, but ever-so-slightly louder voice.
The mud monsters had appeared, as if to block our path.
She whispered, and the next moment,
One of the mud golems was suddenly cut right in half by a diagonal slash.
She hadn't even drawn her sword. She was just standing there.
And yet, one after another, the mud golems were cut through by invisible slashes, and fell apart.
「An instant-draw slash technique that's too quick for the eye!!! Amazing!!!」
This might have been the first time I had ever seen a Stray Blade Style quick-draw swordsman.
「No, wait, are you cutting them with your soul?!」
Koro-senpai's ninja arts were the Soul Escape Arts.
It could be that she was employing those in her swordsmanship.
「（You're sharp. You really do have the makings of a detective.）」
Koro-senpai replied to my murmur, which I had unintentionally let out, with an even quieter one of her own.
Even during that, her invisible quick-draw cuts were bringing down the mud golems.
Like the ones that Hebiko and Nao-senpai were facing, they were coming back to life as soon as they were cut down.
But Koro-senpai's instantaneous sword drawing was faster. The mud golems were just repeatedly collapsing and reviving in the same place.
The figure who had just been running away was no doubt the golems' controller, but
「（We shouldn't get too caught up in this.）」
The mud golems, which had been repeatedly, persistently regenerating, had stopped returning to their original forms.
Which meant that their controller had left the art's range of effect.
With Koro-senpai's unexpected might, we had been able to repel the mud monsters, but the mysterious figure from before had disappeared.
Meanwhile, the other two had been continuing to fight hard.
Suddenly, in front of their eyes, the mud monsters crumbled apart and completely stopped moving.
Hebiko sank down hard, on top of her octopus legs.
Nao hadn't slumped to the ground, but instead irritatedly brushed back her bangs, which stuck to her forehead with sweat.
「I wonder if those two could explain that for us?」
All of a sudden, a laser was fired from one of the little things floating around Nao-senpai, and burned the ground at my feet.
I reflexively leaned backwards in surprise.
「That's my line, Fuuma-kun. And Koro-chan, too. Where did you two go?」
Her eyes were more stern than usual.
「We were in big trouble. Even after we defeated and defeated them, those mud monsters kept coming back to life!」
Hebiko, who had put her octopus legs back to normal, was in a bad mood too.
「Don't get so angry. That was a Mud Escape Art.」
「As the name suggests, they're ninja arts for controlling mud. As usual, I know that because I read it in a book.」
「I take it its range of effect isn't very far. I figured, in that case, the controller must be manipulating them from somewhere not too far away, so I went to look for them.」
「Well, I mean, we needed someone to draw the enemies over here, right?」
「（I do have a quiet voice, after all.）」
Despite apologizing, Koro-senpai had a smug expression.
「You enjoy jerking me around at times, don't you, Koro-chan?」
Nao-senpai was exhausted by the thoroughly detached Koro-senpai.
What an interesting pair they were.
Nao-senpai asked, after putting her dangerous laser emitters away in her Taimanin suit.
「（But we repelled the mud golems. Everyone's safe. That's enough right now.）」
「Fuuma-chan, did you see their face or anything?」
「No, that neither. Just a glimpse of them running away from us.」
「At the very least, it would seem they're related to the case. But they ran away on us, so we've got zero leads, huh?」
「That's not true, Fuuma-kun. You could even call this a breakthrough. We've been waiting for this.」
Koro-senpai also seemed to be pleased.
「It means, as soon as you joined the investigation, we had a development.」
「A development, in the form of being attacked by a mystery enemy! That's Gosha's number one troublemaker for you.」
「Eh?! My senpais were thinking of me like that......?」
「We've heard about your knowledge and command ability from Hebiko.」
「But what we've noticed the most is that you're always at the epicentre of any trouble.」
There were a few occasions that came to mind.
Still, the fact that they were hoping for that was a little depressing.
「It was just like Hebiko said, eh?」
「What did you tell these two about me?」
I took a quick glower at Hebiko.
「Oh, nothing～. Hebiko didn't tell them that trouble pops up around Fuuma-chan just by him standing there, or anything～」
「You did tell them that, didn't you?」
It seemed like she was holding a grudge over having been left behind to face the mud golems.
「In any event, thanks to Fuuma-kun the Troublemaker, the case has progressed.」
「You're right. There might be some kind of clue.」
「Is it okay for me, the troublemaker, to come too?」
「Oh, don't get sulky. Come on, let's go, let's go, Fuuma-chan♪」
Hebiko jogged back to me, and nudged me playfully with her shoulder.
I breathed a sigh, and followed the three of them.
We went inside the house where the murder was said to have taken place.
It was hard to believe a family of three had been murdered, and three Taimanin at that.
There was a strong air remaining of a family having been living here until a short time ago.
「At first glance, there's nothing off about it.」
But then, I was unaccustomed to investigating this kind of incident.
Would it be different in the eyes of a specialist?
Wondering that, I looked at Nao-senpai, and
「There's nothing particularly suspicious to my eyes, either.」
「But, that's what we have Koro-chan for.」
「Exactly. Could you keep quiet for a little while? I take it souls have quiet voices.」
Being told that by Nao-senpai, I shut my mouth.
With soft steps, Koro-senpai stood in the dead centre of the room.
She was looking around without really looking, with somewhat vacant, half-closed eyes.
She had explained this to me earlier, but it seemed that Koro-senpai could perceive signs of living things as traces of their souls moving.
In other words, if it was the work of a living thing, she could tell its movements at a glance.
Koro-senpai stooped down and picked something strange off the floor.
It was a colourful braid, formed into a circle.
It was one of those things that went around your wrist or ankle.
I had never used one, but I had heard that it was a good luck charm, where if the cord breaks on its own, your wish will come true.
「Did the mud user from before leave this here?」
「（Look closely. It's not string. This is made out of human hair.）」
As Koro-senpai said, though it may have been dyed in colourful hues, upon closer inspection, it was made of human hair.
「That's sick. Still, this is a good clue.」
「That's right. The hair is a severed part of a human being. With Koro-chan's ninja art, we can obtain clues from it.」
Koro-senpai placed the misanga bracelet on her palm, and whispered in a quieter voice than usual.
Her right eye, which was normally hidden, became visible.
Koro-senpai began to read the spiritual information that remained in the misanga bracelet.
「（The three of them are related by blood......）」
「Koro-chan, can you identify the owners of this hair?」
「（I can't read that much just from hair.）」
「（That, too, is impossible, just with hair......）」
「（But I'll try to read a little more.）」
She tried to probe around even deeper for spiritual information.
「Assuming that it's from those three...... the three family members who have gone missing......」
「That would mean they left a keepsake as a mark of having killed them. A habit often seen with serial killers.」
「They know we're investigating. That's why they left something like this behind.........」
「Indeed, a provocation...... Or a message to us. Maybe both?」
It was a creepy smile, which I could only describe as bloodthirsty.
Hebiko, meanwhile, expressed her anger in a straightforward manner.
「I don't have a choice. But if this is the only clue, then we don't know anything, do we?」
「That's true. All we can do is take it back to Gosha's lab, and examine it in detail......」
「（Wait. This isn't only three people's hair.）」
Koro-senpai, who had been continuing to use her art by herself all this time, let off a quiet, but sharp voice.
「（There's a fourth person's. Just a few strands.）」
「Does that mean there's a victim we don't know about yet?!」
「（It's just a few strands, but I sense strong thoughts...... It might be the hair of a living person.）」
「Would a sick murderer include something like that in their keepsake?」
「I do hear they have fixations about things like that.」
「Does that mean it's the killer's hair?!」
「That's possible! Koro-senpai, what kind of thoughts are emerging?!」
That was the clue we had been able to obtain from the misanga bracelet that someone had left behind.
